text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — planning to roll the new dedicated autoscale policy to prod tomorrow 02:00 UTC. This changes burst thresholds and cooldowns for the GPU pools (reduces min-burst CPU/GPU reserve, shortens cooldown from 10m -> 3m). No infra churn expected but want an ops + eng eyeball.

Jen: @Alex can you confirm canary % and duration? also who is on-call at that time? :eyes:

Alex: Canary will be 5% traffic for 20m, then 25% for 30m if metrics look good. On-call is Miguel (SRE) and Priya (runtime) for the window.

Miguel: I can take first 02:00-03:30 slot. I'll run smoke checks and watch evictions/queue length. Give me the rollout command and smoke checklist.

Alex: Rollout command: `deployctl rollout apply autoscale-policy/dedicated-gpu:v3`
Quick smoke checklist:
- run health check against canary route `curl -sS https://canary.redwood/api/health | jq .status`
- check queue depth: `kubectl -n inference get hpa gpu-pool -o yaml`
- prom queries: `sum(rate(redwood_inference_request_duration_seconds_count[5m])) by (route)` and `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))`
- watch `redwood_gpu_evictions_total` and `redwood_kv_cache_miss_ratio`

Priya: Add these two quick traces for post-deploy: `trace:inference/response_time` (sample 1%) and `trace:kv/cache_hit` (5%) so we can correlate slow tails to cache misses.

Sam: Who owns rollback? And what's the play if we see a sustained 20% increase in p95 or eviction rate > 2/min?

Jen: Tagging the rollback owner explicitly helps. Also any customers pinned to specific model versions that might be impacted?

Miguel: I'll own rollback. Plan: `deployctl rollout abort autoscale-policy/dedicated-gpu:v3` to revert to v2. If p95 up >20% sustained for 10m or gpu_evictions_total rises > 2/min and error-rate +1% absolute, abort immediately. I will notify #incidents if we abort.

Alex: We expect a small transient p95 bump during prefix cache warming but not >10%. If we see more, abort. No customers pinned to policy-level settings — customers can pin model versions but not autoscale policy.

Jen: Can someone paste the exact PromQL alerts we should watch in the canary window so I can wire them into my dashboard?

Priya: Alerts: `increase(redwood_gpu_evictions_total[10m]) > 20`, `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route)) / baseline_p95 > 1.2`, `redwood_error_rate{env="prod"} > 0.01`

Sam: I'll prep a small runbook snippet in the deploy doc with step-by-step and expected outputs. Will also add links to the dashboards.

Miguel: During canary I'll run these commands and paste outputs in thread: `kubectl -n inference logs deploy/autoscaler -f --since=10m | tail -n 200`, `curl -s https://prometheus/api/v1/query?query=...`

Alex: AVAILABILITY note — plan to do this in low-traffic window, estimated impact <1% token cost variance. Burst capacity should handle transient spikes.

Jen: Any migration or config that requires a restart of the autoscaler pods? If so, include a pod restart step and a graceful drain approach.

Priya: This change is config-only; no planned restarts. If we need to restart autoscaler, do `kubectl rollout restart deploy/autoscaler -n inference` and wait for `availableReplicas == desired`. Add 5m wait to checklist.

Alex: Final owners/roles: Alex (release lead), Miguel (rollback & smoke), Priya (runtime+traces), Sam (docs+dashboards), Jen (QA sign-off). Can we confirm by EOD? :white_check_mark:

Jen: Confirmed. I'll sign off after I get the canary dashboard links.

Miguel: Confirmed. I'll be on-call and will post live outputs.

Priya: Confirmed. I'll enable the 1% trace sampling during canary.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: `autoscale-policy-rollout-v3` starting at 2112432000 (02:00 UTC tomorrow). Canary 5% for 20m -> 25% for 30m. Participants: Alex, Miguel, Priya, Sam, Jen.

Alex: Thanks everyone — I'll post the final checklist and the doc link in the morning. If you spot anything missing ping me here. :thumbsup:
